title: Check the names a list feeder sends before they reach anything a client reads
hypothesis: Lead names from the list feeder were clean.
change: Read the names on the reply cards the client saw.
result: From 10/6 to 10/9 every Zeutara lead name arrived with one stray trailing e on the last name, for three days, on cards the client read. Togari strips it now; the fix belongs in the feeder column.
next_decision: Fix the feeder column; until then strip the e with gtme-reply's name fixer.
check: Run gtme-reply names over a batch of feeder names before they reach a card or a draft; it says whether the feeder appends a letter.
scope: Any lead feeder that writes names into client-facing cards or copy.
